name: Particle Life
tagline: Share the jar from one link. Same mix, your stir, they see it.
description:
Press Share the jar, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send the link. A friend opens it and lands in the same mix — no account, no install, no server. Tap to stir; they see your poke. Playing alone is the original toy.

The mix lives in the file, so the copy you keep is the save.

A jar of tiny coloured specks. Each colour likes some colours and shies from others. From that one rule they bunch into worms, cells, crystals — things that look alive, for a while. Push shoves them away from your finger; switch to Pull and they gather instead. New mix pours a fresh set of likes and shies.

An unofficial port of Particle Life by hunar4321.
